replicate_statements: The data are presented as mean ± SD. Statistical analysis involved Student's t-test and one-way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test.
outputs.explanation: A single 'N=4' is given (apparently near the mitochondrial-fraction graph only, and unclear whether it applies to all three bar graphs), but neither the caption nor the panel states what these four replicates are (e.g. four mice per genotype, or technical repeats of the same blot). Because the type of replicate is not specified, the reporting is incomplete.

The panel shows immunoelectron microscopy images described as representative findings ('Nucleus-dominant distribution...was found', 'the mitochondrial membrane...and matrix...were stained'), implying the observation was made across multiple sections/animals, but no number of animals, sections, or grids examined is given, nor is the replicate type stated.

The panel shows single western blot lanes for each purification method with no quantification and no statement of how many independent purifications/animals or repeated blots were performed to support the conclusion that 'all methods revealed the presence of HMGB1 in mitochondria.'

The proteinase K protection western blot is shown as a single representative experiment with no quantification and no indication of how many times the experiment was repeated or how many biological samples were used, so neither the number nor the type of replicates is reported.
